messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — SEV 2: High error rates and elevated packet loss observed from multiple POPs serving us‑east1. Auto-alert from edge-metrics at 2026-03-15T09:14Z. Paging oncall-network.

raj (oncall-network): grabbing it. seeing spikes in retransmits from edge-us-east3 → origin egress. starting triage.

sarah (sre): thanks. what's the customer impact right now? latency vs errors?

maria (support): we've got 12 incoming tickets, ~20 conversations in the live queue. customers report 500s and timeouts, mostly from east coast users hitting web endpoints.

raj (oncall-network): initial quick check: packetloss ~7-12% between our POP (us‑east3) and upstream transit ASNs, started ~09:10Z. other POPs low loss. Looks like last‑mile or regional transit flap.

ops-bot: @raj assigned incident-1957501234 to oncall-network. Incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-network-packetloss (see section "traffic steering to adjacent POP").

raj (oncall-network): handoff to @sarah for SRE coordination, @tim for runtime fallback config, @eve for infra/BGP changes if needed. I'll open cloud provider ticket after we confirm path.

sarah (sre): copying. action checklist: 1) estimate impacted percentage, 2) traffic steering canary to us-east2, 3) throttle retries at edge, 4) contact ISP/transit. I'll own customer comms with @jordan and @maria.

jordan (customer-success): prepping a short blast to affected customers: "We're investigating increased errors from East Coast — engineers actively mitigating. We'll update in 30m."

raj (oncall-network): running quick traceroutes from telemetry agent to origin via us-east3 POP and us-east2 POP.

raj (oncall-network): ```
traceroute to origin.example.internal (10.1.2.3), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.4 ms
 2  203.0.113.45  3.8 ms
 3  * * *
 4  * * *
 5  198.51.100.12  120 ms  !H  (host unreachable)

traceroute via us-east2
 1  10.0.0.1  0.6 ms
 2  198.51.101.8  4.1 ms
 3  10.1.2.3  6.2 ms
```

raj (oncall-network): traceroute shows blackholing or severe packet loss in intermediate transit (ASN 64500).

eve (eng-infra): can we BGP community steer for affected prefixes to prefer us-east2? I can push temporary communities on the edge-router pool.

tim (eng-runtime): we can flip routing at the edge config to prefer us-east2 for the affected region and also enable per-request fallback to other POPs. I can deploy a canary for 2% traffic immediately.

sarah (sre): do it. @tim start a 2% canary to us-east2 and monitor for 5 minutes. @eve prep the community changes but hold until canary looks good.

tim (eng-runtime): deploying canary now — route override in edge-config pushed to canary tag. ``edge-config set route_preference us-east2 --tag canary-195750``. Rolling in 3 seconds.

ops-bot: Canary deployed: canary-195750 = 2% traffic shifted to us-east2. Metrics: canary_error_rate 0.5% vs baseline 9.2% (at t+2m).

maria (support): customers on the live queue are reporting fewer recent errors after ~09:19Z. Will update the ticket template.

sarah (sre): looks promising. @eve, please start BGP community change to steer the affected prefix toward us-east2 for the next 30m, TTL 30m. Keep a rollback plan.

eve (eng-infra): applying temporary community 65535:200 to advertised prefixes from us-east3 — which tells transit to prefer us-east2? (confirming with transit provider now).

raj (oncall-network): FYI opened provider ticket with TransitCo: INC-88122, referencing packet loss on ASN 64500 affecting our us-east3 POP. They replied "investigating".

ops-bot: metrics update: overall error rate for us-east region down from 9.2% to 1.4% after steering (t+7m). Latency normalized for canary traffic.

tim (eng-runtime): increasing steering from 2% -> 50% in 10m if stability holds. I'll stage change now.

sarah (sre): agree. Keep rollback window 5m for each ramp. Notify if errors spike.

maria (support): sending an update to affected customers: "We've mitigated impact by rerouting traffic; service is partially restored while we continue to monitor. Next update in 30m or earlier." :thumbsup:

raj (oncall-network): a few datapoints: packet capture shows retransmits at AS path hop 3. Running tcpdump on us-east3 egress: ```
09:18:12.123 IP 198.51.100.45.443 > 10.1.2.5.52345: Flags [S.], seq 123, ack 456, win 29200
09:18:12.456 IP 198.51.100.45.443 > 10.1.2.5.52345: Flags [R], seq 124, win 0
... lots of dup acks and RSTs ...
```

eve (eng-infra): BGP change applied and propagated. TransitCo confirmed seeing our new communities and are advertising accordingly.

ops-bot: update: traffic steering ramp to 50% completed (t+15m). Monitoring shows error rate stable at ~0.9% for region.

tim (eng-runtime): 50% -> 100% planned in 10m if stable. Preparing rollback playbook: `edge-config rollback route_preference --tag canary-195750` and `remove community 65535:200` (eve).

raj (oncall-network): TransitCo updates: they found a misconfigured route reflector in ASN 64500 causing intermittent blackholing for specific prefixes. They rolled a fix at 09:34Z and are monitoring.

maria (support): we just closed 8 of the highest-severity customer tickets and updated status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/195750 (note: internal link in thread).

sarah (sre): given the provider fix and our steering, looks like full restoration. @tim proceed to ramp back to normal routing.

tim (eng-runtime): rolling 100% traffic back to original preference (removing override) in 2m.

ops-bot: rolling back canary-195750 overrides.

eve (eng-infra): removing temporary BGP community from us-east3 adverts; will watch for normal path.

ops-bot: final metrics: post-rollback error rate 0.2% region-wide, latency stable.

jordan (customer-success): posting resolution note to customers: "Incident mitigated; root cause transit provider route reflector misconfig — we worked with them to fix and rerouted traffic during remediation. We'll follow up with a postmortem."

raj (oncall-network): marking incident as mitigated. Will hand to postmortem owners @sarah and @eve for RCA.

sarah (sre): agreed. Severity reduced to SEV4 / mitigated. Postmortem owners: sarah (lead), eve (network analysis), raj (timeline), tim (runtime mitigation), maria/jordan (customer impact). Postmortem draft due EOD +48h.

maria (support): closing customer-facing incident page but leaving notes for follow-ups.

ops-bot: incident-1957501234 status: MITIGATED -> awaiting postmortem. Tags: packetloss, edge-us-east3, transit-asn-64500, bgp.

eve (eng-infra): saving captures and configuration diffs to /incidents/1957501234/artifacts.tar.gz and linking to postmortem.

sarah (sre): thanks everyone. Any outstanding action items?

raj (oncall-network): follow-up: confirm BGP session stability with TransitCo in 24h and request a change window for permanent community route policy if they recommend.

tim (eng-runtime): follow-up: add automated traffic-steer playbook to runbook to shorten mitigation time.

maria (support): follow-up: send PSAT to customers who opened tickets offering a 1-week incident credit where applicable.

jordan (customer-success): I'll coordinate credits.

ops-bot: incident thread archived at 1957503299.

sarah (sre): closing channel for now — re-open if new regressions show. Thanks all. :heart:
